_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'PROJECT SCHEDULE' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.03.08.

f01_Project_Start_and_Target_Finish_Date.label: Project Start and Target Finish Dates
f01_Project_Start_and_Target_Finish_Date.guidance: The authorized baseline start date and targeted project completion date.

f02_Schedule_Data_Version_and_Baseline_S.label: Schedule Data Version and Baseline Status
f02_Schedule_Data_Version_and_Baseline_S.guidance: The formal schedule model version number and baseline authorization state.

f03_Total_Critical_Path_Length_and_Major.label: Total Critical Path Length and Major Phases
f03_Total_Critical_Path_Length_and_Major.guidance: Total working days on the critical path and scheduled durations for each major project phase.

f04_WBS_Code_and_Activity_Schedule_Mappi.label: WBS Code and Activity Schedule Mapping
f04_WBS_Code_and_Activity_Schedule_Mappi.guidance: Consolidated schedule line items linking WBS code, activity title, and work package.

f05_Planned_Start_and_Finish_Dates.label: Planned Start and Finish Dates
f05_Planned_Start_and_Finish_Dates.guidance: Approved baseline start date and baseline completion date for each scheduled activity.

f06_Assigned_Resources_and_Effort_Alloca.label: Assigned Resources and Effort Allocation
f06_Assigned_Resources_and_Effort_Alloca.guidance: Designated resource leads, team members, and allocated effort hours per activity.

f07_Critical_Path_Flag_and_Dependencies.label: Critical Path Flag and Dependencies
f07_Critical_Path_Flag_and_Dependencies.guidance: Clear indicator (Yes/No) identifying critical path activities and predecessor linkages.

f08_Total_Float_and_Free_Float_Values.label: Total Float and Free Float Values
f08_Total_Float_and_Free_Float_Values.guidance: Calculated total float and free float values in working days for each schedule activity.

f09_Schedule_Risk_and_Recovery_Considera.label: Schedule Risk and Recovery Considerations
f09_Schedule_Risk_and_Recovery_Considera.guidance: Identification of high-risk scheduling bottlenecks and contingency deployment rules.
